using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Text.Json;
using MediaBrowser.Model.Plugins;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Emby.Server.Implementations.Plugins.Tests
{
    public class PluginManagerTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<PluginManager>> _loggerMock;
        private readonly JsonSerializerOptions _jsonOptions;

        public PluginManagerTests()
        {
            _loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<PluginManager>>();
            _jsonOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions()
            {
                WriteIndented = true
            };
        }

        [Fact]
        public void SaveManifest_ArgumentException_LogsWarning()
        {
            // Arrange
            var manifest = new PluginManifest();
            var invalidPath = string.Empty; // Causes ArgumentException in Path.Combine
            var pluginManager = CreatePluginManager();

            // Act
            var result = pluginManager.SaveManifest(manifest, invalidPath);

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Warning,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.FormattedLogValues>>(logValues =>
                        logValues.ToString().Contains("Unable to save plugin manifest due to invalid value")
                        && logValues.ToString().Contains(invalidPath)),
                    It.IsAny<ArgumentException>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<ArgumentException, ExceptionDispatchInfo>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void SaveManifest_SuccessfulWrite_ReturnsTrue()
        {
            // Arrange
            var manifest = new PluginManifest();
            var tempDir = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"));
            Directory.CreateDirectory(tempDir);
            var path = tempDir;

            try
            {
                var pluginManager = CreatePluginManager();

                // Act
                var result = pluginManager.SaveManifest(manifest, path);

                // Assert
                Assert.True(result);
                var metaFile = Path.Combine(path, "meta.json");
                Assert.True(File.Exists(metaFile));
                var content = File.ReadAllText(metaFile);
                Assert.NotEmpty(content);
            }
            finally
            {
                Directory.Delete(tempDir, true);
            }
        }

        private PluginManager CreatePluginManager()
        {
            // Simplified constructor - only providing required dependencies
            // Note: This is for testing the specific SaveManifest method in isolation
            var mockAppHost = new Mock<IServerApplicationHost>();
            var mockConfig = new ServerConfiguration();

            return new PluginManagerTestFixture(_loggerMock.Object, mockAppHost.Object, mockConfig, Path.GetTempPath(), new Version(10, 8, 0));
        }

        // Test fixture class to handle protected constructor
        private class PluginManagerTestFixture : PluginManager
        {
            public PluginManagerTestFixture(ILogger<PluginManager> logger, IServerApplicationHost appHost, ServerConfiguration config, string pluginsPath, Version appVersion)
                : base(logger, appHost, config, pluginsPath, appVersion)
            {
            }
        }
    }
}
